from bisect import bisect_left

def solve():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    left_part = set()
    right_part = set()
    
    def recurse(start, end, cumsum, container):
        if start == end:
            container.add(cumsum)
            return
        recurse(start + 1, end, (cumsum + arr[start]) % m, container)
        recurse(start + 1, end, cumsum, container)
    
    mid = n // 2
    recurse(0, mid, 0, left_part)
    recurse(mid, n, 0, right_part)
    
    right_sorted = sorted(right_part)
    
    max_sum = 0
    for val in left_part:
        needed = m - val
        idx = bisect_left(right_sorted, needed)
        if idx > 0:
            candidate = val + right_sorted[idx - 1]
            if candidate > max_sum:
                max_sum = candidate
    print(max_sum)

solve()
